Name: Northwind
Details: Northwind was bought by Clan Stuart of the Terran nation of Scotland, who named it after their ancient home on mankind's cradle. Eventually the Northwind Highlander regiments were raised to defend the world, and they became elite mercenaries. After the fall of the Star League, the Northwind Highlanders went into permanent service with House Liao but in 2841 Northwind was captured by House Davion during a surprise attack that destroyed both Highlander regiments garrisoning the planet.
